claim: The fix is `_switch_back_or_refuse` in `hub/hub/worktrees.py`, which switches a clean registered worktree back to `agentweave/<agent>` and otherwise refuses with a message naming both branches.

citations.quote: `_switch_back_or_refuse` in `hub/hub/worktrees.py` switches a clean registered worktree back to `agentweave/<agent>`, and otherwise refuses by naming both branches (`wrong-branch-refusal-names-the-branch`).
